name: Fredericksburg Summer AM 2025
information:
# This competition is in a series.  Please see the Series Competition Scenarios tab for details.

**This competition will take place in the Theater. Check the Venue tab for more information on parking and finding the room.**

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competitor Responsibilities tab. Additionally, we recommend you attend the Newcomers Tutorial at the beginning of the Competition.
